code:
- run: |
    yq -i '.image.tag = "${{ github.sha }}"' \
      apps/cart-service/values.yaml

- run: |
    git commit -am "cart-service: bump to ${{ github.sha }}"
    git push
caption: CI just commits the new tag to a manifest repo — Argo CD does the rest.

eyebrow: Declared in Git, like everything else
code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: cart-service
spec:
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/northbridge-retail/k8s-manifests
    path: apps/cart-service
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true
caption: selfHeal reverts any manual cluster change back to what Git says.
Healthy and Synced — the resource tree shows every piece reconciled to Git.
